One selected SPCX Swing/HA lifecycle resolved as a loss, the selected ETH pullback and GOLD Swing/HA lifecycles remain open with negative marked net PnL, and the other three selected routes have no eligible forward event in this run. Do not infer route edge, remove a route, promote v29, drain v25, restart, place, close, resize, or alter protection from this sparse mixed boundary.
falsifier: The telemetry assessment is falsified by a mismatch in the immutable ledger prefix, live run identity, profile fingerprint, current-run totals, protected open-position facts, or six-route observation set. The portfolio hypothesis remains prospectively falsified by a resolved after-cost sample with nonpositive net PnL and profit factor at or below one, absent both-side exercise, winner concentration above fifty percent, or materially worse live friction. Those outcomes require another append-only revision and remain reported results rather than implicit runtime gates.
